name: Adam Letchford
reason: Third pass: the new Lancaster department profile linked from the OM List (read with curl) repeats the qualifications (PhD Management Science, Lancaster, 1997), fellowships and dated research projects (the earliest, 'Cutting-Plane Approaches to Integer Programming', from 1 January 1997) but no appointment dates. The Lancaster research portal, read through the reader proxy, lists former affiliations Research Associate, Reader, Deputy Head of Department and Honorary/Visiting in Management Science, all undated, so it shows an early research-associate post but not when it began or whether it followed the degree. A discovery search found no dated CV or appointment notice. Earlier review (2026-10-17): his homepage, the Lancaster profile, an empty ORCID and the Mathematics Genealogy record confirm the 1997 Lancaster PhD but date no first post.
